# The Open Media film

- `open-media-film.mp4`: the 64-second film about Open Media's mission and features, 1920×1080 at 30 fps, H.264 with an AAC soundtrack. The README links to it, and the website plays the same file (`assets/landing/film.mp4`).
- `preview.gif`: an 18-second silent loop from the film (the tagline, "One feed." and "Your feed. Your rules."), 800 px wide, shown at the top of the README.

File names: lowercase with hyphens, like the other README assets.

Notes for agents: the source is in `docs/film/`; regenerate both files with `docs/film/render.mjs` rather than editing them.
